reason: Slack free and a shared Notion already cover us for close to nothing, and moving the whole business's chat, docs and tasks into a new tool is a weekend I don't have. The price isn't the problem; the switch is.
objection: If the chat drops messages or goes down, my partner and I lose our main line to each other and to client context. Slack has never let us down, and I don't want our business riding on a small startup's chat.
would_change_my_mind: A one-click import of our Notion workspace and Slack history, plus a track record from other two-person businesses showing the chat is as dependable as Slack.
